description: This is a C# source file for an ASP.NET Core controller named FavoritesController, responsible for handling HTTP requests related to favoriting articles. It has two endpoints for adding and removing favorites, utilizing dependency injection of IMediator for sending commands.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller managing favorite/unfavorite actions for articles, with routes configured for POST and DELETE requests, and authorization enforced.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to add an article to favorites, sending an Add.Command via mediator.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE to remove an article from favorites, sending a Delete.Command via mediator.
